### Overview
Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro is a Portuguese professional footballer born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal [SRC-7d4fa04b7783].
He is widely recognized as one of the greatest players in the history of the sport, celebrated for his exceptional goal-scoring ability, athleticism, speed, and longevity [SRC-7d4fa04b7783].

### Major Career Milestones and Club Statistics
Ronaldo has played for several prominent European clubs and the Saudi Pro League, accumulating a career total of 980 official goals in 1,331 matches as of October 2026. [SRC-7d4fa04b7783]

* **Sporting CP (2002–2003):** Began his professional senior career with 31 matches and 5 goals [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
* **Manchester United (2003–2009, 2021–2022):** Played two spells with the English club, recording 292 matches with 118 goals in his first stint and 54 matches with 24 goals in his second stint [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
During his early years under manager Sir Alex Ferguson, he won three consecutive Premier League titles and a UEFA Champions League title [SRC-7d4fa04b7783].
* **Real Madrid (2009–2018):** Achieved his most prolific club spell, scoring 450 goals in 438 appearances and remaining the club's all-time record scorer [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
* **Juventus (2018–2021):** Contributed 101 goals across 134 matches [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
* **Al-Nassr (2023–Present):** Competes in the Saudi Pro League, where he has scored roughly 136 goals in approximately 148 matches. [SRC-7d4fa04b7783]

### International Career and Honors
Representing the Portugal national team since 2003, Ronaldo has earned approximately 234 caps and scored roughly 146 international goals, making him the all-time leading goalscorer in men's international football [SRC-ed19658c86e6].
He captained Portugal to victory at the UEFA European Championship in 2016 [SRC-7d4fa04b7783].
Globally recognized for his individual excellence, he has won the prestigious Ballon d'Or award five times (in 2008, 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017) (unverified: no matching retrieved evidence).

### Contradictions Note
While source text correctly identifies Ronaldo as Portuguese [SRC-7d4fa04b7783], isolated tags within one retrieved biography page incorrectly categorize athletes from Brazil under certain headings.

01 Biography

Early Life
Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro was born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, Madeira, an island region of Portugal. He grew up in a modest family and developed a passion for football at an early age. His determination and natural talent helped him pursue a professional career despite financial challenges during his childhood.
Beginning of His Football Career
Ronaldo began playing organized football with local youth teams before joining Sporting CP's academy in Lisbon. His performances quickly attracted attention because of his pace, dribbling skills, and confidence with the ball.
Manchester United
In 2003, Ronaldo joined Manchester United under manager Sir Alex Ferguson. Initially known as a skillful winger, he gradually developed into a prolific goal scorer. He helped the club win three consecutive Premier League titles from 2006–07 to 2008–09 and the UEFA Champions League in 2008.
In 2008, he won his first Ballon d'Or, establishing himself among the leading players in world football.
Real Madrid
Ronaldo transferred to Real Madrid in 2009. His time in Spain became one of the most successful periods of his career. He scored hundreds of goals, became the club's all-time leading scorer, and helped Madrid win four UEFA Champions League titles during his tenure.
He also won two La Liga titles and several other domestic and international trophies with the Spanish club.
Juventus
In 2018, Ronaldo joined Italian club Juventus. He helped the team win two Serie A titles and continued to score consistently in domestic and European competitions. His time in Italy added another major chapter to his career across Europe's top leagues.
Return to Manchester United
Ronaldo returned to Manchester United in 2021. During his second spell, he continued to score important goals before leaving the club in November 2022.
Al-Nassr Career
In 2023, Ronaldo joined Saudi Arabian club Al-Nassr. His arrival brought significant international attention to Saudi football. He continued to score goals and contribute to the club while pursuing further career milestones.

Frequently asked questions
How many goals has Cristiano Ronaldo scored in his career?
As of October 22, 2026, Ronaldo has scored 980 official goals for club and country combined — 20 short of 1,000.
Which club did Ronaldo score the most goals for?
Real Madrid: 450 goals in 438 appearances between 2009 and 2018, still the club's all-time record scorer.
How many career assists does Ronaldo have?
293 official assists over his career.
How many goals has Ronaldo scored for the Portugal national team?
146 goals — the most ever scored by a men's international player.
How many Ballon d'Or awards has Ronaldo won?
Five — in 2008, 2013, 2014, 2016, and 2017.
Which club does Ronaldo currently play for?
He has played for Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia since 2023.
Is Ronaldo the all-time top scorer in the Champions League?
Yes — with 140 goals, he's the competition's all-time record scorer.
How many caps does Ronaldo have for Portugal?
233 caps — also a record for the most international appearances by a men's player.
